notes.content:
The Time Has Come Adventurer

Hey everyone, _theRaven here! 

If you are not familiar with me or my game, I call myself _theRaven and I am the solo developer of the Maeldor: Quest of the Artifact. After working for 3 years on it, I have released my passion project and this is my first game on Steam! It is also on quite a big discount -%69-, so if you haven't tried it yet, this might be a good time do it! 👍

Maeldor is inspired by Role Playing Games, a handcrafted story-driven action-adventure platformer! Control a fellowship of 3 heroes as they travel to the Mount Trumnor where the God of Darkness Atronien rules! Discover a magical world, fight your enemies, upgrade your heroes, find treasures, meet locals and be part of an epic quest to save Maeldor!

Below is a video, which belongs to a series called "Let's Play Maeldor!", where I play my own game "Maeldor: Quest of the Artifact" to explain the game to the players who are interested and also to give you some tips/hints about the game so you can beat the levels, whenever you get stuck at some point! Check it out!👇

notes.title: Updates on Development & Release Date
notes.content:
Updates on Development

Hello everyone! Yes it's me, I am not dead and still lurking in these mortal soil you call earth! Hehe.

Since I've buried myself to my indie game dev cave for the development process and have been silent for a while, I just wanted to give you some quick updates about it -like where am I at it, what else left to do etc.- and some info about the release date of my game.

Regarding the development things are going pretty well, and so far I haven't come across with a huge problem -fortunately- which would've slow me down. I've completed the first 4 chapters along with all the cut-scenes, enemies, boss fights, music and other level elements such as traps, treasures, mystery urns and ancient lore books. So as today, I'll start working on the 5th chapter and here are some gifs/Ss for you to check out!

https://i.imgur.com/508yDv3.mp4

https://i.imgur.com/FRWK0R2.mp4

https://i.imgur.com/U3YP3jy.jpg

Alright, so these are the chapters I've completed so far within these past 1 and half month, but what else left to do? Let's talk about that now.

As you might already know, there are 8 chapters in Maeldor, so this means that I've 4 more chapters to complete! This might sound easy, but believe me, there are lots and lots of things to do while finishing one chapter, such as implementing all the features to the levels without breaking anything within the system, re-designing enemies, working on boss fights, adding new stuff to the levels such as new art or new mechanics, composing music or making SFX, and since Maeldor is a story-driven game and I really want to support that part of the design of my game, I spent quite a good time with the cut-scenes and other story elements.

I've set September as a milestone for finishing everything within the game and spent 1 month after that, for testing to find bugs and also polishing the game, so the release date in my mind is October. But as I've told before, I am a solo developer and I do everything myself from coding to art to music etc. and believe me, it's really tough...

My philosophy about making games is giving your maximum effort to make a quality game, so for that, I wouldn't release an unfinished game even if I have to delay the release date. I believe the important thing is the experience you'll get while playing the game, so if there would be some things which bothers me, I wouldn't release the game until I solve them first.

It has been more than 2.5 years since I've started to work on Maeldor, and I hope you are as excited as I am for going on an adventure within this magical fantasy world created by my imagination! Be a strong human warrior, be a skillful elven archer or be a unique water elf and fight alongside with your water soul!

And hey, don't forget to Wishlist Maeldor if you are interested in my work and haven't done that already!

Until we see each other again, don't forget to have fun mortal!

notes.title: #5 Devlog of Maeldor (Characters-Pelethorn)
notes.content:
#5 Devlog of Maeldor (Characters-Pelethorn)

Welcome to the #5 Devlog of Maeldor (Characters-Pelethorn) and now we have come to my favorite character and also the main character of the short stories I’ve been writing, which takes place in Maeldor. He is the source of joy and courage in our fellowship, a natural outcome of his naive personality, our beloved Water Elf, Pelethorn. Oh how I love this character!

Are you excited to learn more about him? If so, grab your coffee and let’s get started!

Blessed Child

https://i.imgur.com/DkwIq73.mp4

Alright, first thing first. Who is he?

He is a water elf, who is blessed with the “Water Soul Summoning” ability, by the divine lake of Neni, when he was just a baby. It is a very old tradition to wash a newborn baby in the waters of the Divine Lake of Neni and on rare occasions, sometimes a part of the lake binds its soul to the baby, surrounding him/her body like a blanket or a cover, and when this happens, it means that the baby is born with the “Water Soul Summoning” ability. I will not tell all his background story since it is a bit too long, and you can actually read it on the Book 1 / Chapter 2, if interested. In my perspective, he is such a unique character and I believe there are so many people who can relate themselves with his thoughts and personality, just like I do.

Water Soul Summoner

Alright that is enough info about his story, now let’s talk about his part in the game. If you are familiar with my game and have been following my devlogs, you must be already familiar with that, every character in my game has 4 type of skills, and this is also valid for Pelethorn. He has 1 fast attack (Punch & Kick), 1 heavy attack (Water Hammer), 1 defensive ability (Water Shield) and 1 ultimate ability (Flood). Other than that, he can also “Dash” like all other playable characters but since he has magic based abilities, instead of Stamina, he has Mana as the source of his powers.

https://i.imgur.com/3PwJbV9.mp4

And what is special or different about him? I think you already guessed it but if you haven’t let me ask you this, do you see that little blue fellow floating around Pelethorn? Well, that is his famous “Water Soul”, and while in normal occasions Pelethorn is not a strong or skilled warrior, thanks to his Water Soul he becomes pretty dangerous to his enemies. Because his Water Soul can change it’s shape and become more solid or form a protective shield around him, also can heal Pelethorn while he is inside the shield, and even draw the waters hidden around them and create a flood!

Skills & Abilities

So let’s talk about his fast attacks first. These are also combo kind of attacks, like Turmaeg, but instead of a sword, he uses his Water Soul to “Punch & Kick” his enemies. His Water Soul covers his fists and kicks, becomes more solid and with the momentum makes the impacts much more stronger, without letting Pelethorn to hurt himself (which he normally would, if he’d hit them with his barehands, hehe).

https://i.imgur.com/tZ2JNna.mp4

His second attack is called “Water Hammer”, and as you can guess from the name, his Water Soul takes the shape of a hammer, and falls down upon his enemies with a great momentum, dealing more damage and also dazing enemies for a short amount of time. Like Turmaegs’ heavy attack, this attack is also slower yet has a feature, and also consumes Mana.

https://i.imgur.com/kC6kgR7.mp4

His special ability is called “Water Shield”, and again I believe you can guess pretty much what is this skill from the naming. It is the only defensive ability he has. With this ability, his Water Soul surrounds him like a shield, covering and protecting him from any incoming damage. And of course, this skill also consumes Mana, since we don’t want him to cover himself forever. If you upgrade this skill, it can also heal him for a certain amount of HP, which is an obvious balancing decision I made while working on him, because after giving it a try for about a week, I thought that he was a bit much vulnerable regarding to other characters. So to balance things out, I decided to give this ability also a healing feature, but remember, it is only available after the first update of the Water Shield skill.

https://i.imgur.com/obMY9ry.mp4

And his last skill… And also his ultimate, “Flood” is the skill I was most excited about to work on, not just because it was one of the most sophisticated function I’ve implemented into my game, but also it is the one that seemed to me as the coolest ability amongst all characters (sorry Turmaeg & Anoriel). As I’ve mentioned before, thanks to his Water Soul he can draw waters hidden around him, like from the depths of the earth or waters which is hidden inside the materials, to create a Flood and choke all the enemies in it. And the last thing I’d like to say about this skill is that it has a cooldown, shocking right? Hehe.

https://i.imgur.com/tcMm3eR.mp4

LAST WORDS

If you’ve read the short stories and learned more about Pelethorn, you might understand why I think that there are so many people out there who can relate themselves with him, because most of the time people who are close to us expect a lot from us and obviously, this creates a pressure within to satisfy their expectations, rather than fulfilling ourselves as a person in life. Pelethorn learned this after many failed experiences, but he finally understood that it is not about fulfilling other peoples expectations, but to finding your own path and living it, and I believe this is true for all of us. In that regard, he is a pretty special character for me.

Alright, we’ve come to the end of the#5 Devlog of Maeldor (Characters-Pelethorn) and I hope you’ve enjoyed it!

As always, it was my pleasure to share my ideas and progress with you and of course thank you so much for sharing your precious time with me!

Lastly, if you feel excited about my work, I kindly ask you to go ahead and Wishlist Maeldor now on Steam, so you can be notified when my game is out!

Until we see each other again in another devlog, have fun!

notes.title: #4 Devlog of Maeldor (Characters-Anoriel)
notes.content:
#4 Devlog of Maeldor (Characters-Anoriel)

Hello and welcome to another devlog! In this one I will be talking about the second character that we will be able to control in Maeldor. Get your coffee and let's begin whenever you are ready!

Favorite Child of the Forest

https://i.imgur.com/IObgdfG.mp4

Our second character, and the character I am currently working on is called Anoriel. She is a wood elf, carrying a legendary bow made by the strong trees of the Narinar Forest, her homeland. She is a very skilled archer, and also the personal guard of the queen of the wood elves, Nulinviel. 

She was sent by the queen herself, by the order of the Forest Spirits to investigate the growing darkness outside their borders and also to aid in any way she can in this fight. Being deeply connected to the forest, she was granted with special abilities and also a dagger forged with the wisdom of her people, which never gets blind and also different kind of sharp arrows with different abilities.

She has 1 fast arrow attack (Arrow Shot), 1 close attack (Dagger Slash), 1 special ability (Fade), and an ultimate ability (Poison Rain).

THEY'LL NEVER SEE HER COMING!

https://i.imgur.com/44ZO5nW.mp4

Her Arrow Shot ability is a bit different than Turmaeg's fast attacks, because she can make a combo by triggering a wounding shot with every third attack she makes, which slows down the enemy for a short amount of time. But of course, her combo must not be broken if intended to perform a wounding shot. 

For example you shot your first arrow, shot your second arrow, and without breaking the loop, if you can shot your third arrow, that arrow will slow down the enemy. It is indicated in the game with a different arrow and a different animation. But if you get hit or stop sending arrows, the combo breaks and you turn back to your first shot. 

She can also send normal arrows while on the air towards the ground with an angle close to 45 degrees, and these attacks can also count in her combo, if done without breaking the loop.

WATCH HOW I DRAW & PAINTED ANORIEL'S DAGGER
[previewyoutube=mmu0UeJdePE;full][/previewyoutube]

To give her some ability to interact with the objects and also to use in close combat, I have added the Dagger Slash attack. This is not just a melee skill for her, this is also an interaction skill, in order to be able to use some of the "must" mechanics of the game such as opening chests, collecting crates or hitting switches, but to prevent players from using this skill like a spam attack, it is designed in a way to consume stamina, so if you don't have any stamina, you can't use this ability. This also creates the situation where players must think twice before using this skill every time they encounter some enemies.

https://i.imgur.com/fDVHtRi.mp4

Her special ability called Fade, is the only defensive ability she has besides her dash ability, which other characters also posses. Wood elves are deeply connected to the spirits of the earth, and this connection creates a bound between them, which helps her to become one with the world around herself, or to become invisible to the unfriendly eyes. Since spirits of the world are energetic beings, she can get information about the energies around her, like which are hostile and which are friendly. But of course this ability consumes stamina, since we don't want her to "Fade Away" from the physical world forever, don't we? No we don't.

And lastly, her ultimate ability Poison Rain is a skill where she shows her Wood Elf abilities, by shooting lots of poisonous arrows to the sky, and dealing damage while also applying a poison effect to the all enemies around her. This skill has a cooldown.

LAST WORDS

I must confess it was quite fun and satisfying to control her, after most of the pieces come together. But of course, this is not the final version, there is still so much room for improvement! If you prefer to control a fast paced character in this kind of games, then Anoriel is going to be your choice!

As always, it was my pleasure to have you read my devlog and of course thank you so much for sharing your precious time with me!

Lastly, if you feel excited about my work, I kindly ask you to go ahead and Wishlist Maeldor now, so you can be notified when my game is out!

Until we see each other again in another devlog, have fun!

notes.title: #3 Devlog of Maeldor (Mystery Urns-Buff System)
notes.content:
#3 Devlog of Maeldor (Mystery Urns-Buff System)

Hey there Maeldorian! Welcome to the #3 devlog of Maeldor, where I will be talking about the “Mystery Urns (Buff System)” of my game. I will explain what kind of a buff system it is, what buffs I have implemented so far, and also to share some of my exciting ideas about all the cool buffs I will be implementing in the future to the system. Did you get your coffee? Alright, lets begin!

WHAT DO WE HAVE HERE?

So what are these “Mystery Urns” exactly? Well, they are one of the reasons why you want to explore the levels, because they contain some sort of an ancient power within them, to be consumed and use. So basically, this is a buff system where you become stronger or get a new ability for your character.

https://i.imgur.com/Szj06JB.mp4

And why did I wanted to add something like this to my game? Well, there are more than one reason behind, and the first one is to strengthen the element of surprise in my game, which is something pretty important regarding the game design. Because of our endless curiosity as human beings, our brains are designed in such a unique way to get joy from surprises, and naturally, while in the design phase, we benefit from that feature of human brain as much as we can in our games.

Second reason is the “Exploration” aspect of the game and to strengthen it. As you can see, if you are willing to discover the levels and get these buffs, you become stronger or get a new ability, which in return can help you significantly while fighting enemies or overcoming obstacles in levels. So these “Mystery Urns” are also a motivation source, to help players to be a bit more curious in situations like “What happens if I go to the right from here, could there be a Mystery Urn there?”.

https://i.imgur.com/wL7FUDS.mp4

And the last reason is to help making the gameplay a bit more dynamic, regarding the mechanics we experience in the game. With these different kind of powers or abilities, the experience provided by the game changes regarding the gameplay, with different mechanics or by strengthening the current ones. And as a result, gameplay becomes a bit more dynamic.

I FEEL SO LIGHT!

https://i.imgur.com/SViRkym.png

“Movement Speed Increase”. This is the first buff that came to my mind while making plans about this system, and I got my inspiration for this buff from the Wood Elves of Maeldor.

They are the fastest and most agile race in Maeldor, and besides inheriting this agility from their racial features, they also have a quite strong relationship with the earth and nature, and because of this harmony their steps and movements are much more aliened with their environments, which results in a faster and more agile movement. This essence is something belong to them originally.

CAN YOU FEEL THE BLOOD PUMPING?

https://i.imgur.com/H7jwTR3.png

Second buff I have implemented into my game is a, “Health Boost”, and for this one, origins of it is open to a debate. In fact there is a pretty heated discussion going on between the Humans & the Dwarves of the Maeldor about the origins of this essence.

The story goes like this; In an ancient war between the Atras & the free peoples of Maeldor, they say that two soldiers; a Human Warrior and a Dwarf Berserker were trapped in a forest, surrounded by the Atras and no way to escape but to fight them. In this dark moment, when the two soldiers lost all their hopes of staying alive, a tree standing beside them begins to cry for them and when her tears fall down onto their wounds, suddenly a mad but vigilant hope begins to grow in their souls, burning in their eyes like flames of pure rage. Their heart beats grow faster, blood pumping into their muscles and their wounds healing in an instant, like they were never happened.

In this moment of anger and insanity, they charge into the ranks of the Atras, and chop them one by one with their weapons, like they were nothing but couple of butter molds for them to cut into pieces. When the Atras see their frenzy, they were so afraid to face their rage and while half of them couldn’t escape from their madness, other ones flee without even looking behind.

And this is the story of this essence. As you can imagine, the debate between the Humans & the Dwarves is; they both claim that their soldier was the only one who got the tears of the divine tree and defeated all the Atras and saved the other. But of course there are no proof to their claims, so we accept the common story for this essence. Hehe.

DID SOMEONE SAY “POWER”?

https://i.imgur.com/mcisKPX.png

“Attack Damage Increase”. You know I had to add this one. It’s just so much fun to be stronger and hit more damage to the enemies! Feeling that power is so much worth to the effort of finding these Mystery Urns.

And what is the origin of this essence? Well we don’t know the origin of it, but what we know is that it was given to the free peoples of Maeldor by the Old Gods, children of Mael, to use it against the servants of the Dark God. No one has ever been able to solve it’s mysterious formula, since it is a gift from the Old Gods, but it is pretty useful, since it can increase the effects and damage of any weapon possessed by someone with a pure heart and a good will. But if someone with an ill intentions tries to posses this power, it can cause their life, so it is not for everyone.

SOME RULES (ACTUALLY ONLY ONE)
If you die, you lose it. That’s it, there is no other rules about this system (yet). So you might want to be extra careful after getting this buff, if you don’t want to lose it by dying in a level. But other than that, there is nothing else I haven’t explained and all you have to do is to explore the levels and find them. After that you are good to go!

ENDLESS POSSIBILITES!
And what aspect of this system makes it so exciting for me, as a developer?

Can you imagine the endless possibilities? I mean just think about it! I can literally make lots of different, cool and exciting buffs!

WHAT ABOUT THE FUTURE?
Yesss! I have so many exciting ideas about extending this system, adding new buffs, cool features or abilities to make the gameplay much more fun, such as opening portals, shape-shifting or sending fireballs, haha! Just hang on with me and we’ll get there one by one! I just can’t wait to start working on them!

ARE YOU EXCITED TOO?
I am so happy to be able to share all this stuff with all other passionate gamers just like myself! So thank you so much for hanging out with me till now, by reading this long devlog, and hopefully, I will create something enjoyable and memorable at the end of my development journey. And if you’d like to motivate me and help me in my journey – Wishlist Maeldor now, so you can be notified when my game is released!

Again, thank you so much for sharing from your precious time to read my devlog, and until we see each other again in another, stay fun!

notes.title: #2 Devlog of Maeldor (Characters-Turmaeg)
notes.content:
#2 DEVLOG Of MAELDOR (Characters-Turmaeg)

12.03.2023 today, and it is raining as I write this #2 devlog of Maeldor. I have made some coffee for myself, playing some soft music on the background and gonna enjoy writing this devlog, so why don’t you spoil yourself by getting something to drink or eat, while reading this devlog? Alright, you go ahead and get it, I’ll wait. No problems, hehe.

A PROUD WARRIOR

Ready? Alright, let’s begin!

In this devlog I will talk about the first character of my game, Turmaeg in a bit more detailed way; like how he was created in the first place, his background story a bit and his gameplay style/skills.

If you have written my first devlog, you must know that the idea of my game was emerged from a world created by my imagination called “Maeldor”, which I have been writing some short stories about at the beginning, and after some time it has evolved into something much more bigger, a living, breathing, growing world. You can check out the first part of it from link below on my blog.

Book 1 / Chapter 1

KUULIS’ FAVORITE

He is an orphan, and no one actually knows a lot about his past, his parents or where he was from, but the only thing we know is that, he was rescued by Andurians when he was just a baby, after a group of Atras attacked his village. Andurians are an elite group of soldiers, formed by skillful dedicated warriors from all around the Maeldor and he was raised by them, learned how to fight, survive in the wilderness, protect himself against magic and many other things.

After long years of traveling, fighting and helping those who are in need, he was given an impossible task by the Goddess Kuuli (Goddess of the Moon) personally. No one knows what was the task, but Turmaeg completed it successfully, and upon that, Goddess Kuuli rewarded him with an enchanted armor and a magical sword, forged in the heavens by using metals and ores from the stars, which he can call upon the energies of the celestial beings. Even though his rewards were great, they say that he was changed after completing this secret task, become more silent but also more angry with a quick temper.

HE IS READY TO FIGHT!

So this is the short version of his story. Now let’s talk about his part in the game.

Obviously as you can see, he is a tank-warrior kind of character, a bit more slower than the other characters regarding the movement and attacks, but also a character who can deal and absorb more damage than Anoriel & Pelethorn.

He has 2 regular skills (Fast and Heavy attacks), 1 special ability (Moon Drop), and 1 ultimate (Invincible).

His fast attacks contains 3 different attack styles, one called “Slash”, one with a back flip attack called “Wind Cut” which he can attack both the enemies in front of him and behind, and one called “Whirlwind”, which he turns 360 degrees around himself to attack both sides again.

https://i.imgur.com/0S1s32j.mp4

On the contrary, his heavy attack (Deep Slash) is only one type of attack style, which he cuts the enemy with a brute force, dealing more damage than fast attacks and also knocking the enemy back immediately. This attack is of course slower than his fast attacks, but has it’s own benefits and using them is entirely up to your play style, regarding the situation or the enemies you are facing. Also another benefit of this skill is that, it has a good range, so if you don’t want to come so close to an enemy, might be a good choice, depending on the situation of course.

And his special ability, which is called “Moon Drop”, he summons the plasmatic energy of the Moon to his sword and explodes onto his enemies, dealing great amount of damage everything on its way, and again to the both sides. This ability is something we need to charge before being able to use, and the method to charge it is so simple; using our sword. As we hit enemies, destroyables, switches, chests or any other objects that are intractable with our sword, charges our Moon Drop ability.

https://i.imgur.com/QM5PEUT.mp4

Lastly, his ultimate skill, “Invincible”. This ability is again a blessing he got from the gifts of Goddess Kuuli, just like his Moon Drop. This ability completes his definition of perfect defender, as he again summons the energies of the celestial beings, but instead of using it to attack enemies, this time he contains it inside the Moonstone which is in the middle of his chest, and produces a protective shield around himself, until the power he summoned consumed totally. He does not take any damage as long as the shield is up. This skill has a cooldown.

https://i.imgur.com/vpKNaf4.mp4

LAST WORDS

Alright! So that was a fun devlog to work on, and I hope you have enjoyed it too! I haven’t talked about the upgrades, features of his weapons or attributes he will have, because I am thinking about covering those kind of topics in another devlog, under the “Upgrades” category.

Have you finished your drink? I have finished both my coffee and this devlog, hehe. One last thing I ask from you dear Maeldorian, if you feel excited about my game and this world I am creating, go ahead and Wishlist Maeldor today, to help me and also to be notified when the game is out!

Until we meet for another devlog, have fun!

notes.title: #1 Devlog of Maeldor (General Game Design)
notes.content:
#1 DEVLOG Of MAELDOR (General Game Design)

Hello and welcome adventurer! I am the Raven, solo developer of Maeldor and I am so excited to share the first devlog of my game. I will explain the general game design, what milestones I have achieved so far, and what other development stages left to do before I release the full game. Of course the development is going a bit slow, since I am a solo dev and I literally do everything myself for this game, from coding, to art (%90 of the things you see in this game is handcrafted by me), to music and all other stuff.

WHERE MAGIC AND SWORD RULES

First of all, let me describe my game to you briefly, in case you are not familiar with it. Maeldor is a story-driven 2d action adventure platformer with RPG elements in it. It is a lore-rich game, heavily depends on the magical fantasy world called Maeldor, created 4 years ago by my imagination. It builds itself around an epic story filled with different adventures throughout the Maeldor, mixed with lots of action aspects and since it has features such as character progression, decision making or skill trees, we can say that it also has some RPG elements in it.

I don't want to spoil everything, but for now let's say that our objective in the game is to get back a precious ancient artifact, stolen by the servants of the God of Darkness, the Atronien. The artifact is so important to the free folks of Maeldor, because it holds a secret which will be useful in the upcoming war against the Atras (servants of Atronien).

WHAT I HAVE DONE SO FAR?

Here is the list of things I have done so far;

[olist]
 1 Playable Character Completed,
 All 8 Chapters Arts, Level Designs and All Other Elements Completed,
 Mystery Urns (Buff System) Completed,
 1 Boss Fight Completed,
 Complete Story Written Down and First Part Implemented,
 9 Soundtrack and lots of SFX Made and Implemented to the Game,
 Menu UI and UX Designs Completed,
 3 Enemy Design, Animation and Gameplay Style Completed,
 1 NPC to Discover Different Stories of Maeldor Completed,
 Chests and Soul Points System Implemented
 Gamepad Support Implemented.
[/olist]

WHAT ELSE LEFT TO DO?

[olist]
 2 Other Playable Characters,
 7 Boss Fights,
 Other Enemies in Chapters,
 Upgrade System
 Polishing and Other Little Things
[/olist]

LEGENDARY HEROES ARE SUMMONED

We will have 3 playable characters in the game, Turmaeg a skilled warrior raised by an elite force called Andurians, Anoriel a wood elf who carries a legendary bow called "Tura", and Pelethorn blessed by the divine lake of Neni with the "Water Soul Summoning" ability. We also have our wise wizard Aglaroth, but he is not a playable character, rather he is a supportive character (NPC) who will guide us in our journey throughout the Maeldor with his wisdom. Each character will have different skills, features and abilities to make the gameplay dynamic for you according to your choices.

A DARKNESS IS GROWING

You will explore all the magical realms of Maeldor from beginning to the end and this makes 8 Chapters with each containing 3 Levels in them. Every chapter of the game takes place in a different environment with different enemies and different interactive elements such as dangers, traps or gameplay opportunities. 

YOU WILL BE TESTED

And yes of course we have boss fights! At the end of each chapter you will fight an end level boss to make progress in the game, which makes 8 boss fights with each unique styles and gameplay.

HARDER, BETTER, FASTER, STRONGER

You will be able to upgrade your characters' skills, weapon features and racial attributes by collecting something called "Soul Point" throughout the levels and also from treasure chests, to become stronger, since that will be the only way for you to get to the end of the game, unless you have some insane gaming skills.

A DESIRE TO EXPLORE

If you choose to complete all the objectives in a level, such as defeating all the enemies, finding and collecting all the chests, you will be rewarded at the end of that level. Also there is something called as "Mystery Urn", a buff system I have designed for Maeldor. Each Mystery Urn contains a different kind of power to make your character stronger and gives you benefits over your enemies. So I strongly encourage you to tap into that inner explorer of yours!
